# Shine of the Ghoul Update: Expected changes for March 18, 2025 (Patch 58)

![Glow of the Ghoul Update: Expected Changes for March 18, 2025 (Patch 58)](/uploads/466_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

The next update and the next season 20 are already around the corner. On **March 18, 2025**, the **Ghoul's Ghoul** **Update for Fallout 76** will be released and brings with it numerous new features, the playable Ghoul, a new seasonal event, a season dedicated to the Ghoul, new game mechanics, new locations, new perks and much more. 

### Index:

## The playable ghoul & new quests

With this update it will be possible to play Fallout 76 as a **Ghoul**. This means you are completely **immune to radiation**, you even benefit from it, are healed by it and you get over 100% life "**Glow**" through radiation. This glow is the basis for your buffs and perks.

First of all, you are always human when you come out of the Vault. From level 50 it is then possible to complete the quest "**Off into the Unknown**" and "**Fresh Genes**", where you can become a **Ghoul**. 

It is also possible to become human again; you can simply select the appropriate option in the character menu. However, this step back is probably only possible once free of charge.

Using preview graphics and entries in the PTS data, it was already possible to see via data mining that a **"re-ghoulification" was to be offered in the Atom Shop**. At what price you can't see there. There are also entries for a **"Level 50 Boost"** via the Atom Shop. This is primarily intended to enable quick access to the ghoul quests for new characters. However, additional character slots do not seem to be planned.

So it's best to think carefully about which character you want to use to become a ghoul. Being a ghoul has advantages and disadvantages.

### Advantages:

- **Immunity** to radioactive radiation
- "**Glow**" by radiation (over 100% TP)
- **"Wild"** condition can provide benefits through ghoul perks
- New **Ghoul Perks**
- Significant **Resistance ability**
- Boost **Chems** with Ghoul Perks
- **No** hunger or thirst, instead being in a “wild” state
- Boost weak point hits with ghoul perks
- Critical hits boosted by ghoul perks
- More specials when a ghoul is on the team through ghoul perks
- etc.

### Disadvantages:

- "Wild" condition can cause disadvantages, can be improved with chems.
- No Bloodstained build possible
 - Radiation is used for healing, so it doesn't persist like it does as a human. This means you can't keep your HP at a Bloodstained level.
- **No** benefits from **Unyielding** armor permanently possible
- Without **disguise** you cannot enter or fast travel to the interior of Crater, Foundation, Vault 79, or Fort Atlas. You can get the disguise from Jaye Vo in Radiant Hills
 - Power armor or any scarves or similar do not currently count as disguise
- Significant charisma penalties (-10 without disguise)
 - As a ghoul, you get poor prices from merchants and have disadvantages in some dialogues.

### Possibilities as a ghoul

Basically, the ghoul is definitely an alternative to a bloodstained build, as it also offers many advantages and can withstand significantly more. However, this won't convince you if your main goal is XP farming and you always play with the maximum XP buffs. The ghoul cannot offer you that.

For full-life players, the ghoul is an even more interesting alternative, as it also has full life and an additional bonus due to its "glow".

![Ghoul glow on TP bar](/uploads/nukaknights-post-ghoul-glow-bar.png) 

The "**Glow**" can easily be controlled with **Toxic Slime**. Put poisonous slime on yourself
